We must waddle forward. We must fight!
We must take a stand and take the bread that we-|audio = NerdDuckQuote.ogg|'''Nerd Duck''' in the opening cutscene for [[Bathroom Approach]]}} }} ==Description== The '''Nerd Duck''' is the main antagonist of the [[Duck Hunt Event]] and [[Ducky Revenge Event]], later turning into an ally to the [[T.D.S. Organization]]. With him leading the ducks in both of his main events, he can be considered the de facto leader of the ducks and potentially the [[Duck Realm]] as a whole. The '''Nerd Duck''' is a smart character which has invented many things. Most notable of his inventions are his mechs, which are the two Ducky D00M mechs, [[Ducky D00M (D00M's Revenge)|II]] and [[Ducky D00M III|III]], and also a [[Nerd Ducky|Mecha Bunny]]. These mechs are used by him to fight others, as he is not a particularly effective fighter without them. His other inventions include the [[P3NGU (Ducky Revenge)|P3NGU]] and a [[Bunny Sentry]], which ends up being stolen by the [[T.D.S. Organization]]. He also shows his intellect through other means, like his work on merging the [[God Cube]] during [[Null & Void Event]]. ==Personality== The '''Nerd Duck's''' defining trait is his intelligence. This leads to his dialogue often being used to explain complex things to other characters. During the [[Ducky Revenge Event]], his intelligence also impressed [[Professor V]], causing her to ask him to work with her, something he agreed to. He is a good leader, as he has managed to convince ducks to help him reach his goals in both the [[Duck Hunt Event]] and the [[Ducky Revenge Event]]. He also managed to get these ducks to build his inventions for him. The '''Nerd Duck''' has been shown to use any means necessary to achieve his goals. This is best seen in [[Ducky Revenge Event]], where he sends out [[Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|ducklings]]{{InlineQuote|A new duckling filled with gentle quacks and boundless possibilities.|[[Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Duck]]'s description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} and [[Grandmother Ducky|elderly]] to fight the [[T.D.S. Organization]]. He also ends up sending out members of his army with [[Explosive Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|explosives strapped to them]], and sees no issue with doing so.{{InlineQuote|They strapped a bomb to a duck! Don't you think that's pretty extreme?!|[[Dispatcher]] on Wave 13 ([[Bathroom Approach]])}}
{{InlineQuote|NOT AT ALL!|[[Nerd Duck (Narrator)|Nerd Duck]] on Wave 13 ([[Bathroom Approach]])}} It can be assumed such actions are why he ends up getting labelled a war criminal by other characters.{{InlineQuote|As for the duck? He's a hit or miss. I think the dude's a war criminal.|[[Dispatcher]] on Wave 3 ([[Banlands]])}} ==Abilities & Characteristics== {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align: center; margin:1em auto" ! colspan="2" |Other |- |'''Intellect''': '''Nerd Duck''' is shown to be quite intelligent, as he has invented giant mechs, worked on merging the [[God Cube]] fragments and helped get the [[T.D.S. Organization]] agents back from the [[Old World|Nil Zone]]. |[[File:NerdDuckPlan.png|200px|center|thumb|'''Nerd Duck''' presenting a plan]] |- |'''Giant Mechs''': '''Nerd Duck''' uses giant mechs as his main method of fighting others. They are, like his other inventions, created with the help of other ducks. |[[File:NerdDuckMech.png|200px|center|thumb|[[Ducky D00M III]] being constructed]] |} ==Story== ===Duck Hunt=== The '''Nerd Duck''' forms an army of ducks and penguins to attack the [[T.D.S. Organization]] as revenge for what happened to his father, [[Ducky D00M (Eggy Island)|Ducky D00M]], in the [[Spring 2020 Event]]. He attacks a harvest that the [[T.D.S. Organization]] was managing with his army of aquatic avians and a giant [[Ducky D00M (D00M's Revenge)|Ducky D00M II]] mech, but ends up being defeated by them. He then retreats and ends up in the [[Duck Realm]]. ===Ducky Revenge=== The [[Duck Realm]] stops receiving bread ever since the events of the [[Operation I.C.E Event]], leading to the ducks there starving. The '''Nerd Duck''' decides to check up on the portal in the toilet to see if it is active again. There, he finds out the portal is still broken, however, he stumbles upon a [[God Cube]] fragment in the trash, placed there by the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]].{{InlineQuote|Once [[Ramiel]] used the card and messed up their portals, I hid a shard in their toilet!|'''Narrator''' on Wave 9 ([[Blind Faith]])}} After this discovery, he shows what he has found to other ducks, then reveals his plan to them, which involved an all out attack on the [[T.D.S. Organization]] who were blamed for the bread not being delivered. He quickly mobilizes an army and gets multiple ducks to start constructing the [[Ducky D00M III]] and a few [[Bunny Sentry|Bunny Sentries]]. He then starts a speech which is interrupted by three [[T.D.S. Organization]] agents. This leads to a fight between [[Nerd Ducky|Nerd Duck]] and the [[T.D.S. Organization]]. During this fight, the [[Bunny Sentry|Bunny Sentries]] end up getting stolen by the [[T.D.S. Organization]] and used against the ducks. The fight ends with the [[T.D.S. Organization]] first fighting the [[Ducky D00M III]], then the [[Nerd Ducky|Mecha Bunny]] destroying both. ===Null & Void=== ====Night 1==== The '''Nerd Duck''' helps [[Professor V]] work on the Project God Merger, which involved merging the [[God Cube]] fragments the [[T.D.S. Organization]] has collected and merging them all for better control over them. This ends up failing and the fragments become unstable, opening up various rifts to the [[Old World|Nil Zone]]. The crisis is averted once the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] arrives and takes the [[God Cube]] fragments, but he also ends up sending away some [[T.D.S. Organization]] agents. ====Night 2 & 3==== After the [[Commander]], [[Scout]], [[Minigunner]] and [[Dispatcher]] end up getting banished into the [[Banlands|Outer Nil Zone]] by the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]], he and [[Professor V]] start working on a way to get them out of there. Eventually at the end of [[Blind Faith]], they successfully open a portal behind the [[T.D.S. Organization]] agents, taking three of them back to [[Outpost 16]].
